preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBlacklistEnabled(victim_address, true) or setBlacklistEnabledMultiple([victim_address], true) to blacklist any wallet from selling tokens. This will cause the antiSnipe.checkUser() call in finalizeTransfer() to revert when the blacklisted address attempts to sell, effectively preventing them from selling tokens.
